zh: 练习页重新排过了。进来先是一屏设定：中间一个大号数字是这一轮真正会学到的张数，上面在「卡片 / 测验」之间选，下面能调每轮数量、自动朗读、随机顺序、先显示译文；测验模式只留它用得上的两项，其余整行收起来而不是灰着让你按不动。按下「开始复习」才进卡片，翻面前后的圆钮、答案按钮和评分按钮都待在原地——手机上卡片不再因为释义变长而突然长高、把按钮从手底下推走；「显示答案」现在是一条通栏。同步也改成手动：不再有后台轮询，词只在你点「立即同步」时走动；但一台刚登录、从未同步过的设备仍会自动拉第一轮，免得新手机打开是空的。
en: The practice screen has been rebuilt as two steps. You start on a setup page: a large figure in the middle is the number of cards this round will actually cover, with a Cards / Quiz switch above it and options below for the round size, read-aloud, shuffle and showing the meaning first. Quiz mode keeps only the two options it uses and hides the rest instead of leaving dead switches on screen. Tapping Start review opens the cards, and the round buttons, the answer button and the grade buttons now stay in the same place before and after you flip a card — on a phone the card no longer grows with a long definition and shoves the buttons out from under your hand, and Show answer is a full-width button. Sync is manual now: there is no background polling, so your words move only when you tap Sync now. A freshly signed-in device that has never synced still pulls one first round on its own, so a new phone does not open empty.
